name: PandaLM
description: PandaLM is an automatic evaluation benchmark designed to assess instruction tuning optimization of large language models (LLMs). It evaluates models not only on objective correctness but also on subjective factors such as conciseness, clarity, adherence to instructions, comprehensiveness, and formality, using a judge LLM trained on human-annotated data.
reputation: An early and moderately cited benchmark for judging instruction-following quality, especially for subjective response attributes.
notes: Focuses on subjective evaluation criteria beyond objective correctness; avoids API-based evaluation to prevent data leakage.
